definitions.gloss: invincible; unbeatable; matchless; having no rival
definitions.explanation: Having no rival or opponent who can defeat you. Used in sports, games, and figuratively for anyone or anything that is overwhelmingly dominant.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{無敵|むてき}だ。
examples.english: That team is invincible right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{無敵|むてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}っている→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧。
examples.english: He boasts unbeatable strength in kendo.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{無敵|むてき}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{年|とし}を{重|かさ}ねる→年を重ねる：20549_toshiwokasaneru⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧⟦{謙虚|けんきょ}→謙虚：00215_kenkyo⟧になった。
examples.english: When I was young I thought I was invincible, but as I got older I became humbler.

notes:
Literally means having no (⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧) enemy/rival (⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧). Describes a state of being unbeatable or having no match.

USAGE:
- Can function as a noun or a na-adjective: {無敵|むてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧ or {無敵|むてき}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧
- Used in sports, games, martial arts, and figuratively for anyone or anything dominant
- Very common in video game terminology — {無敵|むてき}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧ (invincibility mode), {無敵|むてき}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (invincible state)
- Also used hyperbolically in casual speech: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無敵|むてき}だ (her smile is unbeatable)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無敵|むてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧: unbeatable strength
- {無敵|むてき}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: invincible state
- {無敵|むてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{艦隊|かんたい}→艦隊：14076_kantai⟧: invincible fleet (the Spanish Armada)
- ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧なし: having no match wherever one goes (idiomatic synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最強|さいきょう}→最強：13073_saikyou⟧: the strongest — superlative rather than absolute; implies comparison
- {不敗|ふはい}: undefeated — focuses on the record rather than the quality
- {天下無双|てんかむそう}: peerless under heaven — a more literary/dramatic synonym
